cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group cash mainly supports PRC cement/concrete operating entities; no parent/subsidiary cash-location or fast upstreaming disclosure, so PRC subsidiary/group cash is discounted conservatively.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included in detachable pool after preserving necessary operating cash separately.
cash_breakdown.source: 2025 Annual Report p.69 and note 26(c) p.152-153

cash_breakdown.item: Bank deposits with original maturity over three months, current portion maturing before 31 Dec 2026
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Current bank deposits maturing within roughly 12 months at reputable banks, but cash sits in the group/PRC operating system without proven rapid dividend path.
cash_breakdown.reason: Can mature into cash for debt repayment, dividends, buybacks or redeployment.
cash_breakdown.source: 2025 Annual Report p.69 and note 26(b) p.152

cash_breakdown.item: Bank deposits with original maturity over three months, non-current portion maturing in 2027 and thereafter
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Longer-than-one-year deposits, no disclosure of penalty-free early withdrawal or cash-location split; use lower end for long-term PRC deposits.
cash_breakdown.reason: Detachable in substance but timing and upstreaming friction are materially higher.
cash_breakdown.source: 2025 Annual Report p.69 and note 26(b) p.152

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - unquoted fund investment
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unquoted fund investment has uncertain liquidity and fair-value exit path; apply low haircut factor for unlisted fund/long-term investment.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially saleable but not high-certainty cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Restricted bank deposits - government restricted accounts, bills payable deposits and long-term security deposit
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Government restricted accounts, bills payable guarantee deposits and long-term security deposit do not satisfy detachable-cash conditions.
cash_breakdown.source: 2025 Annual Report p.69 and note 26(a) p.152

cash_breakdown.reason: Controlling acquirer must repay or assume the debt.
cash_breakdown.source: 2025 Annual Report p.70 and note 30 p.157

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve about RMB700m, roughly 1.5-2 months of 2025 operating cost/cash needs, given cement manufacturing working capital and cash-flow volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Needed for raw materials, fuel, logistics, wages, taxes and operating buffer.
cash_breakdown.source: Analyst estimate from 2025 Annual Report p.68 and p.73-74

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Main assets and cash are in the PRC operating system; statutory reserve, tax, FX and dividend/upstreaming frictions remain after item-level haircuts.
cash_breakdown.reason: Avoid treating subsidiary cash as immediately distributable parent cash.
cash_breakdown.source: Analyst estimate based on 2025 Annual Report note 26 p.152 and reserves disclosure p.71

profit_quality.assessment: Cement/concrete earnings are cyclical and at a low point. 2025 turned profitable, but operating cash flow was only RMB201.8m and capital expenditure was RMB702.8m, leaving negative free cash flow after capex. Use 2023-2025 median parent profit of RMB85.7m as pre-haircut distributable cash profit, then apply a 0.35 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Do not count interest income on the large bank deposit balance as sustainable operating earnings after cash extraction.
FVTPL fair-value gain of RMB27.3m and ECL reversal of RMB49.7m are not high-quality recurring cash earnings.
Potential interest savings after debt repayment are not enough to offset cement-cycle volatility, heavy asset reinvestment and working-capital absorption.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow: 2023 RMB1,531.8m, 2024 RMB459.7m, 2025 RMB201.8m. Capex: 2023 about RMB325.8m, 2024 RMB481.4m, 2025 RMB702.8m. 2025 free cash flow after capex was negative.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cyclical industry, recent turnaround from loss, weak 2025 free cash flow after capex and ongoing capital commitments; apply 0.35 rather than merely flagging weak cash quality.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2025 operating cash flow/profit for the year is about 2.26x only because profit base is low; after capex, cash is not distributable.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2025 capex was RMB702.8m and capital commitments were RMB533.2m. Exact maintenance/growth split is unavailable; main case reflects heavy reinvestment through profit haircut.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 inventories increased RMB18.3m, trade/other receivables increased RMB244.8m, and trade/other payables decreased RMB151.2m, creating significant working-capital cash absorption.
